title: ixxiga xongolo
intro: Sahlin xongoloh ixxiga inki adda waktik taturteh tan fayitte tabisse. ta muuci, xer cediyyih barkat, miracsenta liggiditteh inkih yan marah raqteh tan caddo sinni barittot taturte. Atu too qangooruk derret tanih tan kinnaane baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu Yallih xaquk kaxxa barkat yomcowweeh, yi sorkocô baxaa kee mesenkaca iffonta acwa.
Anu inni kacnoytah baxa fan ufkune, liyoh an mango caddo le gadda tabsam niyaata.
Anu takkaawiseh too gibdi zulmi waklentit xisaanam inki numma rabbi luk.
Anu kassiiseh qilsa takke way, xaahi addat hinnay qaraanak darrel qeltut tan, Yallih gabat gacsele.
Anu xaleenah dirki yakkuh amriseh, ammirtimiyya dubuk gitah tan caagiidal tanim takkay immay.
Anu sahlin adabi barseh: ardi bagul rammitle gurral gexaay, isi xongolo fantiita; kaxxam gibdi xongolo danan xongolo.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
